items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I worked there at Dreamland for so long... Bill Bottoms was owner of the place... Mr. Bottoms was such a nice, honest man. He was there right on the dot, he'd pay us.

ctx.x: Yeah. She had a band, too. And sometimes her band would play.
Well, I worked there at Dreamland for so long, and I did so well that Mr. Bottoms heard about Louis, Louis Armstrong. Louis was down South, and Bill Bottoms was owner of the place, as I said.
